note: A fabricated $70,000 amalgamated loan with a 7-year term, worked one year at a time under ITAA 1936 s 109E(7). Each figure was worked by hand from the sources below before the engine was run.
sources: ITAA 1936 s 109E(7) (ATO Legal Database, read 26 November 2026): interest 'is payable on the balance of the loan from time to time in a year of income at a rate equal to the benchmark interest rate for the year of income'.

ITAA 1936 s 109N(2) and the ATO's 'Division 7A - benchmark interest rate' (last updated 1 July 2026, read 26 November 2026): 8.77% for the income year ended 30 June 2025 and 8.37% for the income year ended 30 June 2026.

ATO, 'Loans by private companies' (last updated 2 July 2026, read 26 November 2026): interest 'is calculated annually in arrears by reference to the daily balance throughout the year', a repayment reducing the balance from its own date (61, 272 and 32 days over 365).
ATO Division 7A calculator, scripts unchanged on 26 November 2026 from the hashes in docs/ato-calculator-interest-comparison-2026-11-13.md: each period's interest rounded to cents half up.

cases.derivation: 70000.00 x 0.0877 x 365 / 365 = 6139.00: every day from 1 July 2024 to 30 June 2025 counts. Nothing is repaid, so the unpaid interest is not added and 70000.00 stays unpaid.
